prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bright tropical jungle boardwalk of wooden planks with a waist-high rope rail, large green leaves and standard-height steps, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Swedish woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, very pale, cool skin, a soft white-silver highlighter along the cheekbones, nose bridge and brow bones, pale icy-blue eyeshadow with a fine silver shimmer, pale softly brushed blonde brows, curled light-brown-tipped lashes, large pale-blue eyes with bright real catchlights, a sheer frosted pale-pink lip, a cool, calm, faraway expression, deep burgundy wine-red hair styled in a natural afro in a full rounded silhouette, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted amethyst drop, and on the other ear a large bronze hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a lead pyramid-shaped lump, an iron cube-shaped block, a gold miniature anvil, a tin teardrop-shaped sinker), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered rose-gold rings. Extremely long round nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her hips and rear so wide; a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist sits above hips and a rear so massively rounded and projecting that they dominate her entire silhouette from every angle, the rear itself curving outward and upward in a high, rounded, gravity-defying shape; a full round bust above the cinched waist, gigantic thick thighs meeting the rear's curve, thick soft arms; her head looks small on top of her body; not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Russian Palekh miniature lacquer (a deep black ground with fine gold linework and firebirds), wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense jewel-toned scenework filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme red platform stiletto ankle boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Korean man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a delicate beautiful-boy face with long lashes, a slim straight nose and a clean jawline, clean-shaven, light smoky eyeliner and glossy skin, luminous porcelain skin, a calm gentle gaze, pure icy-white hair styled in a chin-length bob, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large bronze hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a gold round bell, an iron pyramid-shaped lump, a lead teardrop-shaped sinker), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three platinum necklaces. Extremely long coffin nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful, classically muscular man, far beyond any real person, in the shape of a Greek statue. Wide shoulders, a full defined chest, a clean six-pack abdomen, strong rounded arms, and muscular thighs and calves, balanced and proportionate from head to toe, powerful and enormous. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His bare skin is painted in Peruvian Nazca painted pattern (a deep terracotta ground densely painted with stylised gold figures), wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense stepped geometric borders filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every muscle and bulge. The paint covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: both hands sweeping his hair back.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme black plain stiletto pumps with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
